title: Accredited Program mark application · Quick guide
slide_intent: Place a program identity so both its affiliation and its name remain legible. The extra line of type changes the boundary the designer must protect.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can support local program identification while preserving the same file, placement and contrast discipline used for the international mark.
demonstration: Four horizontal checks pair instructions with file icons, corner placements, a clearance diagram and ground examples. The lockup examples include the program name.
practical_value: Check clearance around the entire program lockup. Choose the two-color version on white or a single-color treatment with sufficient contrast.

content_islands.name: Production and position
content_islands.spec: Use large red numerals beside the first two rows. Align the EPS and PNG guidance, corner diagrams and measured program placement to the right.

content_islands.name: Program clearance
content_islands.spec: Show the program-name line beneath the wordmark inside the enlarged clearance diagram.

content_islands.name: Background tests
content_islands.spec: Group acceptable and crossed examples into two-color and single-color columns. Retain the program name in the small specimens.
